watch.summary: A streamer claims he is terrible with the Sheriff pistol in Valorant right before hitting back-to-back headshots for an impressive quadra kill.

beats.what: Streamer claims he was never meant to be 'the Sheriff guy'
Gets a single kill during warmup
A brief sad black-and-white edit plays, instantly interrupted by a double kill
Hits a clean triple kill headshot
Streamer screams in utter shock and disbelief at his accuracy
Lands a fourth headshot for a quadra kill
Streamer continues screaming and loses his mind

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I was never meant to be that guy, I would never be that guy.
watch.why: The instant comedic irony of downplaying his skill right before popping off with four straight headshots makes this clip fun to watch. His high-energy screaming and reaction turn a cool gameplay clip into a funny moment.
